title: MembershipCreated
description: A person joined an organization on one side of the market, or a removed membership came back. A person holds at most one live membership per side. The full state is sent, so a consumer upserts it.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

membership_id.description: Stable id of the membership; every later event about it carries the same one.

org_id.description: The organization the person works in on this side.

side.title: MembershipSide
side.description: The side of the market the membership works on: the organization's kind. `platform` is GoWay's own staff.

role.description: The role the side's tokens carry, for example `carrier`, `shipper` or `superadmin`.

org_role.title: OrgRole
org_role.description: What the person is inside the organization: `owner` for the account that opened it, `member` otherwise.

created_at.description: When it was created or came back. ISO 8601 with offset.
